messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> service=canary-serving, alarm=canary-5xx-rate, severity=high. Trigger: canary cluster 5xx > 8% for 2m. Link: https://pd/redwood/canary-serving/alerts/3219876543

matt_h: ACK. jumping in. pulling logs now.

sarah_g: I see p95 from canary jumped and 503s from runtime pods, suspect kernel quant path. timeline?

jason_p: saw deploy ~3m before alert. rolling canary v2.17.3 -> v2.18.0. canary traffic 10%.

emily_r: tagging: @oncall-next — FYI I'll stay on until we hand off.

matt_h: quick customer impact: internal telemetry shows user-facing error rate up ~1.3% overall, major impact limited to canary tenants (~2.5k requests/min). Not full fleet yet.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: INC-98765 acknowledged by matt_h. Escalation timer paused.

matt_h: trying safe rollback to previous canary image. running:
```sh
kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/canary-serving -w
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/canary-serving canary-serving=redwood/canary:2.17.3
```

incident-bot: Note: automatic fallback policy enabled. Routing divert to v2.17.3 allowed if rollback succeeds.

jason_p: logs show repeated kernel WARN then 503s:
```
E 15:21:34 runtime.cpp:cache_miss - kvcache miss for prefix, exceed mem, returning 503
W 15:21:35 quant.cpp:kernel - fp16 kernel OOM after chunked matmul
```

emily_r: ops-bot run check:mem for canary pods:
```json
{"canary-01": "gpu_mem: 88%", "canary-02": "gpu_mem: 92%", "canary-03": "gpu_mem: 91%"}
```

matt_h: Rollback initiated, starting at 15:22:05. Will monitor.

sarah_g: Can we temporarily divert traffic to dedicated pool (no canary) while rollback finishes? That buys time for QA.

jason_p: yes - doing gradual traffic shift via router flag:
```json
{"route": "service/canary", "from": "v2.18.0", "to": "v2.17.3", "percent": 100}
```

ops-bot: routing change accepted, propagation ETA 30s.

incident-bot: Auto-mitigation: traffic diverted away from canary nodes; cache warmup suspended.

matt_h: Confirming 503s down to baseline, p95 back to normal in ~45s.

sarah_g: Phew. Good catch. What's next? PD escalation still open?

pagerduty-bot: INC-98765 currently acknowledged by matt_h, no further escalation.

emily_r: I'm creating a quick postmortem note and capturing the prompt set that triggered the regression. Will add logs and timeline. Assigning RCA to eng-runtime.

jason_p: Root hypothesis: v2.18.0 introduced a quantization kernel change that increases transient memory use under certain sequence-length distributions -> kernel OOM -> 503. Repro in staging with long prompts.

matt_h: For immediate follow-ups: 1) keep canary traffic off until patch, 2) add perf guard rails in rollout job (memory smoke), 3) add an alert for sudden GPU mem surge.

sarah_g: I'll open an ops-ticket to block future rollouts until memory smoke test passes. Ticket: OPS-4121.

emily_r: I'll send a short customer note to affected tenants saying we detected and rolled back a canary regression, no further action required.

matt_h: handing off final on-call to sarah_g at 15:24:42. I'm available for questions.

sarah_g: ACK handoff. monitoring at 15:24:42->15:54:42.

incident-bot: Thread closed by rollback and routing diversion; add follow-up: RCA due EOD tomorrow.

matt_h: adding action items in the incident doc: https://docs/redwood/incidents/INC-98765

emily_r: thanks team :thumbsup:
